chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The opinion of the old man is more beloved to me than the determination of the young man; and it is narrated: more than the martyrdom of the young man.

key_terms.الشَّيْخِ: The old man, elder, or senior

ai.seo_question: What is the preference of Imam Ali regarding the opinion of an elder versus the actions of a youth?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) prioritizes the seasoned judgment of an elder over the physical prowess or steadfastness of a youth, emphasizing that wisdom often outweighs raw strength. The variant reading comparing the elder's opinion to the young man's martyrdom (*mashhad*) further elevates the value of experienced counsel, suggesting that strategic insight can be as meritorious as heroic sacrifice. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on *hikmah* (wisdom) as a guiding force in both personal conduct and communal leadership.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 86. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
I love the opinion of an old man more than the determination of a young man; (or according to another version) more than the martyrdom of a young man.
